blocks.text: Introduction: To become a member of a family, you are either born or adopted into it. The new birth is the way you are born and adopted into the family of God. It is a spirtual experience that transforms you from the kingdom of darkness into the kingdom of God. It is both a spiritual and moral change. Christ lives in you by the Holy Spirit. It is so vital an experience that no one can enter into God's Kingdom without it.
These things are good and important but they will not substitute for the new birth {{eph 2:8,eph 2:9,eph 2:10|Eph 2:8-10}}; {{tt 3:5,tt 3:6,tt 3:7,tt 3:8|Titus 3:5-8}}

cards.heading: 2. What then is New Birth? Jn. 3

blocks.text: It is a spiritual birth. Our spirit, not flesh becomes born again. Every man must undergo this second birth to receive power to become a child of God. It is the process of substituting the Adamic, that is, the sinful nature, to the nature of God, which is the nature of His Holiness.

cards.heading: 3. Why is the New Birth So Important?

blocks.text: The nature of Adam on any man will stand against him at the gate of heaven if not substituted, as explained earlier, before he gets there because;

items: Man is spiritually dead and cannot obey, understand or please God. {{rm 8:6,rm 8:7,rm 8:8|Rom. 8:6-8}}; {{jr 17:9|Jer. 17:9}}; {{eph 2:3|Eph. 2:3}}
He must be re-born if he is to "see" or "enter" the kingdom of God. {{jo 3:3,jo 3:4,jo 3:5|John 3:3-5}}
Without the new birth the natural man is the child of the devil. {{jo 8:44|Jn 8:44}}; {{1jo 3:10|1 Jn 3:10}}
The natural man is corrupt in his affections and perverse in his will. {{gl 5:19|Gal 5:19}}; {{mk 7:21,mk 7:22,mk 7:23|Mk. 7: 21-23}}
The new birth affects our taste, habits, opinion, desire, appearance and hope. {{2co 5:17|II Cor. 5:17}}
Through the new birth, we are raised from death of sin to life of righteousness
How Can I be Born Again?

cards.heading: 3. Why is the New Birth So Important? (continued)

items: Confess your sins to God - {{1jo 1:9|I John 1:9}}
Forsake or turn away from your sins and old ways - {{is 55:7|Isa. 55:7}}; Prov.18:13
Believe Him and His substitutionary sacrifice - {{jo 3:16|John 3:16}}; {{2co 5:21|II Cor. 5:21}}
Receive Him into your heart by faith and thereafter thank God for saving you - {{jo 1:11,jo 1:12|John 1:11- 12}}; {{eph 2:8|Eph. 2:8}}
